convention: Native direct-sector IPI pivot*10 + exact quarterturn, parent*local quaternion; float32 native stores. Server +145Y remains separate. Raw retains historical diagnostic convention.

nativePrefabRotations.parentEligibility: Direct METR SCIN sector SIDI only; constructor resets EPI parent+30, sector parser sets SID parent+34. Unknown/nested/EPI refused.
nativePrefabRotations.floatStores: signedi16*10; composed translation; rotated point; translated point; each final quaternion component. No normalization.

omissionPolicy: Every conflicting native key variant remains excluded, even if transformed poses coincide. Unsupported actual nested/EPI parents, invalid flags, and missing resources refuse export; blank resource aliases are recorded, not guessed. No first/last variant policy.
